summary: Targeted regression after code-quality refactor (photo endpoints, get_file, Wizard stable React keys). All requested checks PASS. Backend fast suite: 32/32 in-scope pytest cases green (photo check/upload with new _validate_image_dims helper, file serving 404/200, order-creation pricing math for single/multi-char/coupon/consent/photo-required, admin auth guards, coupons lifecycle, admin settings + /api/config reflection, tickets create+list+admin-reply, admin stats shape). The 4 pre-known TestGenerationAndRegen failures (fal-pulid upstream 502) were NOT re-run as requested. Frontend: Wizard stable-key fix verified — main character name+photo preserved after adding+removing extra characters, non-removed extra character (Nour-Friend) correctly slid from index 2 to index 1 with its relation intact; sibling list preserves prior two names after adding a third; state survives step navigation. Full happy path Wizard->/pay/{id}->COD->/track/{id} works, wizard-total shows 3400 DZD. Admin dashboard tabs (orders/pricing/tickets/reports) all render post-login.

minor.issue: Exceptions from storage.get_object are swallowed by a bare 'except Exception'. This works, but obscures non-404 failures (e.g. S3/minio transient error) as 404. Consider narrowing to catch NoSuchKey/FileNotFoundError only and letting other exceptions surface as 500.

issues: Sibling/friend name/age/relation inputs have no data-testid (only add-sibling/add-friend buttons do). Adding data-testid="sibling-name-{i}" etc. would make automated regression against future refactors more robust.

action_items: NONE — regression is clean. Optional: (1) add data-testid attributes to sibling/friend inputs; (2) narrow get_file exception handling to filesystem-not-found only.
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_image_dims correctly returns a 3-tuple (w, h, err) and is reused by both check_photo and upload_photo — clean deduplication.
get_file now uses try/except around storage.get_object with 404 fallback — improvement over prior version, but see minor above.
Wizard.jsx: uid()+_id on characters/siblings/friends and c._id / p._id as React keys — correctly prevents state bleed on add/remove. Verified in browser.
server.py still 826 lines — consider splitting admin/orders/tickets routers (unchanged from iteration 3 recommendation).
Bare 'except Exception' in get_file could mask real backend errors as 404. Low-priority tightening.

success_rate.backend: 32/32 in-scope (100%); 4/4 slow AI tests intentionally not re-run per review scope
success_rate.frontend: 100% — Wizard state preservation, full happy path, admin tabs all pass

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed orders (TEST_Sara, TEST_TicketOrder, TEST_Regen, TEST_UIx) created; coupon TESTPCT10 upserted; one new ticket created via TestTickets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor did not regress anything. Photo check/upload use _validate_image_dims helper — confirmed with small/large/invalid inputs. File serving returns 404 for bad paths and 200 with PNG bytes for uploaded paths. Wizard stable React keys (_id) verified: removing a middle character preserves siblings' input state and main character name+photo; adding a 3rd sibling preserves prior two. AI generation tests (TestGenerationAndRegen) were intentionally skipped per review request; the pre-existing fal-pulid upstream 502 blocker from iteration_3 is unrelated to this refactor and should be tracked separately.
